title: The Body and the Five Senses
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: The Body and the Five Senses Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify the major parts of the human body and the five senses; describe how the senses help us learn and stay safe and how healthy habits keep our bodies strong. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Needs and Characteristics of Living Things)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on body parts, the five senses and staying healthy, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: We learn with our five senses.
key_sub: Sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch help us learn and stay safe.
body_html:
How to think about it

Our five senses help us learn about the world.

  • Eyes see, ears hear, the nose smells.
  • The tongue tastes, the skin feels.
  • Healthy food, sleep and play keep us strong.
Example

Which sense helps you hear a bell?

ears

Answer: hearing

Example

Why wash your hands?

germs

Answer: to stay healthy

Common mistakes

  • Thinking we only touch with our hands (our whole skin feels).
  • Thinking senses cannot warn us of danger.
